description: The file is a Java implementation of a service class 'CountryServiceImpl' that provides operations related to countries in a sales management system, including retrieving country data, adding descriptions, and handling caching.

classes.name: CountryServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of country-related service operations, including fetching and caching countries and their descriptions.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a country by its ISO code.

methods.name: addCountryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a country and updates it.

methods.name: getCountriesMap
methods.description: Returns a map of country ISO codes to Country objects for a given language.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries matching provided ISO codes and language.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves all countries for a given language, utilizing caching.
